answer: Each identity passes a harbor roll call: at a random minute it presents its onyx seal live at a knoll checkpoint and signs a sixty-second challenge. A seal needs a 45-credit deposit; a duplicate loses it. One operator cannot answer two roll calls at once, so the kth fake still needs a kth operator at 30 credits plus its 45-credit deposit: 1,000 fakes cost 75,000 credits and need 1,000 operators at once. A rented-operator farm fails: harbor timestamps expose an operator serving two seals at once, and both deposits are lost. An honest agent attends once for one refundable deposit.
